title: Launchpad Orbit — micro-playlist for first-week console mastery
creator: Amira Chen
description: Design and prototype a lightweight in-product micro-playlist called 'Launchpad Orbit' that surfaces three progressive, skippable learning modules inside the Redwood Console: Dashboard first-touch, Rollout basics, and Cost Explorer primer. Target: new accounts and returning users who haven’t configured a rollout or viewed cost breakdowns. The companion should be persistent but unobtrusive, with clear dismiss and snooze controls.
background: Current onboarding funnels focus on full walkthroughs and seeded projects, but analytics show a high drop-off between account creation and first dashboard query (median time-to-first-query = 22 minutes) and low engagement with Rollouts and Cost Explorer features. Existing empty states are static and rely on discovery. We need a modular, contextual education surface that reduces time to first meaningful action and improves cost literacy without increasing UI noise.
goal: Decrease time-to-first-dashboard-query to under 7 minutes for first-time users and increase Rollout creation from new accounts by 20% within 4 weeks of release. Improve initial cost-awareness: bump users who open Cost Explorer at least once in first session from 9% to 30%.
acceptance_criteria: Three modular steps implemented as lightweight overlays/cards (Dashboard, Rollout, Cost) that can be completed, skipped, or snoozed
Each step includes a short action (eg. 'Run your first dashboard query', 'Create a canary rollout', 'Open Cost Explorer') and a one-click CTA that launches the relevant console view
Companion respects user-level preference (dismiss persists across sessions) and complies with accessibility contrast and keyboard flows
Telemetry hooks instrumented: impressions, CTAs clicked, skips, snoozes, dismissals, completion per step
Design handoff artifacts (Figma frames + interaction specs) attached and reviewed by ENG and PM
Prototype validated in two user sessions (internal) and updated with feedback
decision_log: 2025-02-11: Chosen micro-playlist over full tour to reduce cognitive load and enable selective learning (decision by PM + Design)
2025-02-12: Companion positioned as bottom-right persistent card; alternative banner rejected due to metric interference with top-of-page CTAs
2025-02-14: Steps limited to three to preserve brevity; technical fallback will use simple modal if companion cannot render in embedded scenarios
2025-02-16: Telemetry proposal accepted: record impression, CTA, skip, snooze, dismiss, complete; create lightweight heartbeat to avoid over-instrumentation
implementation_notes: Prefer client-side rendered companion with server-side flag for eligibility (new_account and not_seen_rollout) to avoid extra backend routing
Animation budget: micro-interactions only; avoid full-page transitions to keep latency low
Design tokens: use existing console color tokens; create new semantic token for 'assist-cta'
Accessibility: all CTAs must be reachable by keyboard and announced by screen readers; include aria-live region for step transitions
Fallback: if third-party blocking prevents companion, show an enriched empty-state illustration with inline CTA
